name: organ-browser
mission: Provide sovereign, account-aware web perception and safe interaction for agents without leaking secrets or letting untrusted web content become instructions.
empirical_basis: Superteam Earn requires search, filters, detail pages, auth-only surfaces, and safe form inspection.
Browser Hub was reachable, but tab and window ownership remains rough for long autonomous sessions.
Direct Chrome CDP is powerful but bypasses organ policy unless wrapped by a governed adapter.
owned_data: screenshots and traces with redaction policy

tools: Browser Hub with explicit human approval

interactions.contract: Provide normalized page evidence and safe action affordances for bounty workflows.
Send redacted traces, screenshots, source URLs, hashes, and replay notes.
Emit JSON observations for material discoveries, blockers, and irreversible-action gates.

risks: Prompt injection through bounty descriptions or sponsor pages.
Accidental mutation while logged in through personal Google.

next_experiment.objective: Wrap Browser Hub and CDP behind a policy-enforced adapter that records every action as JSONL and blocks mutate-class actions unless a human gate object is present.
success_criteria: Can inventory Superteam Earn filters and details without raw authenticated dumps.
Can inspect a submission form without submitting.
Produces replayable evidence bundle with redacted screenshots and route metadata.
